decisions.reason: The burner component builds on the firm's core radiant-heater business and supports its established systems, so the invested engineering and the component's integral role make withdrawal unlikely despite its low visibility.

The firm has publicly committed to this multi-model electric panel line with its own web page, and electrification fits its announced shift to lower-carbon heating, so any weak early sales would be attributed to market ramp-up.

The halogen heater has its own web page and extends the firm's electric offering for outdoor and spot heating, so a single product only a year on the market would be kept and given time rather than written off.

The industrial electric hall heater is close to the core business, comes as a full model line with prominent web presentation, and is central to the electrified hall-climate direction, so commitment to it is strong.

The hydrogen-ready dark infrared line embodies the firm's announced low-carbon strategy, so slow uptake would be blamed on the immature hydrogen infrastructure rather than the product, and the firm would persist with it.
